senses.gloss: f. (קָדַד or קָדָה) bowing to the ground.
units: Succ. 53ᵃ נועץ שני … והיא ק׳ he pressed both his big toes against the floor and bowed and kissed the pavement …, and this is ḳidah.
Meg. 22ᵇ a. e. ק׳ על אפים ḳidah means falling on the face (ref. to I Kings I, 31).
Ib. אחוי ק׳ וכ׳ showed the way of ḳidah …, and became lame; (Y. Ber. I, 3ᶜ bot. הראה כריעה); a. e.
